Украина (Ukraina, “Ukraine”) + -о- (-o-) + питек (pitek, “austropithecus, brute”). Originally coined in mockery towards Ukrainian nationalist beliefs about their country as "the oldest nation in the world", later used to dehumanize Ukrainian nationalists and people in general as fanatics, or Ukraine itself as a backwards country.
